第2828章 辞别福利（第1页）
林铭俯身摆放灵石的同时，无形的精神力悄然铺开，如水波般漫过周遭一众制符修士。
这片公共制符区域内，足足有上百名修士同时落笔绘符，人声低低，符纹灵光此起彼伏，看着颇为热闹。可林铭一眼扫过，心中便已有了分明判断。
百人之中，真正在身周布下灵石、提前做好灵力储备的人，屈指可数，寥寥无几。
寻常中品、上品符咒，消耗灵力温和，炼气修士凭借自身丹田储备，完全足以支撑完整绘制，无需额外借力。
极品符纹成型刹那，会产生极为狂暴的灵力虹吸，瞬间抽干修士体内灵力。
单凭炼气期自身底蕴，根本撑不住最后成型的关键一刻，强行炼制只会灵力枯竭、符纹崩碎，最终落得失败的下场。
但凡真正炼制出过极品符咒的人，都深谙其中诀窍。
唯有提前在身周布下灵石，时刻预备吸纳外界灵力，兜底填补瞬间巨量消耗，才有炼制成功的可能。
换言之，此地所有未曾铺设灵石的修士。
今日看似潜心制符，实则从一开始，就彻底与极品符咒无缘。
扫视一圈，确认周遭众人底细，林铭缓缓收敛心神，摒除一切杂念，全心投入炼制之中。
他制符经验早已炉火纯青，数年沉淀下来，亲手铸就的极品符咒早已逾数百张之多。
对于极品符纹的运转轨迹、灵力把控、节奏拿捏，早已刻入本能，纯熟到极致。
整套动作行云流水，一气呵成，没有半分滞涩犹豫。
笔尖灵光平稳流淌，一道道精密繁复的冰系符纹稳稳烙印在符纸之上，纹路规整、寒气内敛，层次分明远超旁人。
旁人绘符尚且步步谨慎、频频停顿微调，唯有林铭落笔如风，节奏从容不迫，每一道灵力输出都精准到极致，不差分毫。
一炷香不到的时间，整张符咒的主体纹路已然彻底成型。

就在主体纹路合拢的瞬间，符纸骤然一颤，一股狂暴无比的吞噬之力骤然爆发！
淡淡的冰蓝色灵光自符纸升腾而起，刺骨寒意悄然扩散，整片区域的空气都微微降温。
符咒之内仿佛诞生了无形黑洞，疯狂拉扯周遭一切灵力，林铭丹田内的灵力不受控制，顺着手臂飞速奔涌而出，尽数灌入符纹之中。
原本漫不经心扫视全场、负责值守的筑基期陈石，目光瞬间锁定林铭身上，眼底骤然掠过一丝凝重。
周遭一众埋头制符的修士，也纷纷察觉到异样，下意识抬眸望来。
都是常年钻研制符之人，众人眼力皆是不凡。
单单这股恐怖的灵力虹吸之势、符纹震荡之态，他们瞬间心知肚明，有人，要成极品符咒了！
而且看这符纹寒气、属性走势，赫然是攻击类灵符！
面对着近乎抽空丹田的巨大消耗，林铭神色依旧平稳，不见半点慌乱。

Chapter 2828 Farewell Welfare (Page 1)
While Lin Ming leaned over to place the spirit stones, invisible spiritual power quietly spread out, spreading over the surrounding talisman-making monks like water waves.
In this public talisman-making area, there are hundreds of monks writing talismans at the same time. The voices are low, and the talisman patterns are illuminated one after another. It looks quite lively. But Lin Ming glanced at it and already had a clear judgment in his mind.
Among the hundreds of people, there are only a handful of people who have actually placed spiritual stones around themselves and prepared spiritual power reserves in advance.
Ordinary middle-grade and high-grade talismans consume moderate spiritual power. The Qi Refining Monk's own Dantian reserves are completely sufficient to support the complete drawing without the need for additional help.
The moment the top-grade talisman is formed, an extremely violent siphon of spiritual power will be produced, draining the monk's spiritual power instantly.
Relying on its own foundation during the Qi refining period, it simply cannot survive the critical moment of final formation. Forced refining will only lead to exhaustion of spiritual power, shattering of runes, and ultimately failure.
Anyone who has truly refined the best talismans knows the secrets.
Only by placing spiritual stones around the body in advance, always ready to absorb external spiritual power, and making up for the huge instantaneous consumption, can the refining be successful.
In other words, all the monks here who have not laid spiritual stones.
Today, it seems that he is concentrating on making talismans, but in fact, he has completely missed the opportunity to make the best talismans from the beginning.
After glancing around to confirm the details of everyone around him, Lin Ming slowly gathered his mind, discarded all distracting thoughts, and devoted himself to refining.
His experience in making talismans has long been perfected, accumulated over several years, and he has already crafted hundreds of top-quality talismans with his own hands.
The movement trajectory, spiritual power control, and rhythm control of the best runes have long been engraved into his instincts, and he is extremely proficient.
The whole set of movements was done smoothly and smoothly, without any hesitation.
The spiritual light from the tip of the pen flows steadily, and the precise and complicated ice rune patterns are stably imprinted on the rune paper. The lines are regular, the coldness is restrained, and the layers are far clearer than others.
Others drew the talisman step by step carefully, pausing frequently to fine-tune, but Lin Ming wrote like the wind, with a calm and unhurried rhythm, and every spiritual power output was extremely accurate, without missing a beat.
In less than a stick of incense, the main texture of the entire spell has been completely formed.
At the moment when the main lines were closed, the talisman suddenly trembled, and a violent devouring force suddenly erupted!
A faint ice-blue aura rose from the talisman paper, a biting chill spread quietly, and the air in the entire area cooled slightly.
An invisible black hole seemed to be born within the talisman, pulling at all the spiritual energy around it wildly. The spiritual energy in Lin Ming's dantian was uncontrollable, rushing out along his arm, and pouring all of it into the talisman.
Chen Shi, who was in the Foundation Establishment Stage and was on duty as he was scanning the entire audience casually, immediately locked his gaze on Lin Ming, and a hint of solemnity suddenly flashed across his eyes.
The surrounding monks who were busy making talismans also noticed something strange and subconsciously raised their eyes to look up.
They are all people who have been studying and making talismans for many years, and their eyesight is extraordinary.
Just from this terrifying siphon of spiritual energy and the oscillating state of the runes, they instantly knew that someone was going to become a top-notch rune!
And looking at the cold energy and attribute trends of this talisman, it is clearly an attacking spiritual talisman!
Facing the huge consumption that nearly emptied his dantian, Lin Ming's expression remained calm, without any trace of panic.
